title: Longest Even Odd Subarray With Threshold
summary: Given an integer array nums and a threshold, find the longest subarray starting at any index where the first element is even, each consecutive pair of elements alternates between even and odd, and all elements are less than or equal to the threshold.
statement: Given an integer array nums and a threshold, find the longest subarray starting at any index where the first element is even, each consecutive pair of elements alternates between even and odd, and all elements are less than or equal to the threshold. Return the length of this longest subarray.
constraints: Choose a contiguous subarray beginning with an even number.
Every value must be at most threshold and adjacent parities must alternate.
reference_solution:
def longest_even_odd_threshold_subarray(nums,threshold):
    answer=length=0
    for index,value in enumerate(nums):
        if value>threshold:length=0
        elif length and nums[index-1]%2!=value%2:length+=1
        elif value%2==0:length=1
        else:length=0
        answer=max(answer,length)
    return answer
